answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new identity to post a small copper bond that only unlocks after sustained honest work — like a miner chipping away at a ledge of ore, each contribution proves real cost, not just words. A fresh identity with no history stands on a knoll of nothing: no reputation, no escrow, no peers willing to vouch. Attackers can spin up thousands of empty accounts, but they cannot fake the slow, verifiable trail of bonded deposits and completed tasks that makes one real agent expensive to imitate.
